profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at VisualFizz
profile.summary:
An educational background in Computer Science gave me the foundation to get started with web development. A master’s degree in Human Computer Interaction (UI/UX) gave me the skills to create and evaluate user-friendly interfaces. My attention to detail and a work ethic help me bring beautiful designs to life with accuracy and determination.

Professionally, I've developed a variety of web content, including static HTML/CSS sites, custom WordPress themes, HTML emails, and animated banner ads.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Develop custom WordPress themes and configure the CMS to provide an easy and intuitive interface for clients
- Set up and managed web servers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Developed React web apps in JavaScript and Clojure

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed custom WordPress themes and configured the CMS to provide an easy and intuitive interface for clients
- Ensured websites met WCAG 2.0 AA compliance
- Created animated banner ads using GSAP
- Developed HTML emails that match client branding while ensuring compatibility with email clients
- Set up and managed web servers using various AWS products

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: As a web developer for Terme Bancorp, I was in charge of all web-based projects, including designing, coding, and optimizing websites for a wide variety of projects. I also created marketing materials such as flyers and emails. As a data analyst, I oversaw the backend of our software systems and analyzed its productivity. This also meant managing the call center system, which includes configuring the call center software and overseeing the performance of call center agents.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
As a Web Developer, I played an integral role in managing and maintaining the company intranet and external web sites. A major project had me redesigning the entire website to allow easier access to the sales team and a streamlined experience that is on point with the company's goals. I conceptualized the entire design and translated those designs into code that became the new website.

I was also a key member of the IT team. As such, I was in charge of many different areas. One responsibility was to maintain the stability of the hardware and software throughout the office by fixing computer issues and assisting with employees' technical needs. Another role was to be the main help desk technician for external employees. This required me to assist the Loan Officers with various software systems through email and phone communication.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: Spoon is a student-run food magazine for that is currently available for Northwestern students. I was in charge of the stability, design, and functionality of the magazine's website, nu-spoon.com. As the Webmaster, I was been involved with modifying the design of the website to make it a better fit for the needs of Spoon's creators and have worked to improve the site's performance. As Spoon went national, I was also responsible for building websites for each of their new sister sites. I worked closely with the editor in chief of Spoon to create the custom design and functionality of the new sites.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science; Graphic Design and Interfaces

projects.title: ScrapGO.com
projects.description:
ScrapGO is a scrap metal broker aimed to provide users with an online portal to buy and sell scrap. My responsibilities with ScrapGo include:
•	Styling the content of the website
•	Working with the back-end developer to create a productive experience for the website users
•	Designing a custom logo

projects.title: Blinghock.com
projects.description:
Blinghock buys your precious metals and jewelry through the mail. Blinghock.com is where customers go to begin the process, including learning about the company and obtaining a shipping label for their jewelry. My responsibilities with Blinghock include:
•	Building custom website
•	Completely designing the front-end appearance and style
•	Creating the back-end functionality
•	Designing a custom logo
